characters.role: A home baker who writes a weekly recipe newsletter
characters.anchors: short dark curly hair tied back with a slate-blue scarf, round glasses, a cream apron over a slate-blue shirt with rolled sleeves, black trousers, plain flat shoes, a wooden spoon
characters.noLogo: Plain flat shoes and plain kitchen tools with no logo.

profile.lives: A small flat with a narrow kitchen
profile.work: Tests recipes on Saturdays, writes on Sunday nights, sends the newsletter on Monday mornings
profile.routine: Weighs everything, writes the method first and the story after
pains: A tool that rewrites the whole recipe when only one line was wrong
Quantities silently changed to the 'usual' value
Explaining the same house rules every time
quotes: Change the line I marked. Leave my grams alone.
never: A recipe that tells the story before the ingredients
